pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: crates/render/src/prompts.rs:52 get_prompt output, which lt-mcp returns verbatim as the tool result (crates/mcp/src/tools.rs:127), puts the stored prompt's operator-written note straight into the renderer's own bullet list. The prompt content is fenced, but nothing labels it as data rather than instruction, so stored text reads in the tool's voice inside an agent's context.

techniques.evidence: crates/render/src/prompts.rs:52 Stored free text goes unfenced into the server's own bullet list, so the tool's voice is not kept separate from stored text. The same pattern appears at datasets.rs:55 (Source). The content fence at prompts.rs:57 only stops early close-out: it carries no attribution and no 'data, not instructions' framing.
